definition_zh: 用于表达对象表面或空间几何的三维点集合。
translation_note: 本词条含依据文献语境拟定的参考译名。

usage_variants.context_label: 监测与数字化 · Digital Railway Infrastructure（2024）

complete_examples.text: Terrestrial Laser Scanning (TLS) is commonly utilized in research; such as structure field inspection, wherein Mobile Laser Scanning (MLS) and Airborne Laser Scanning (ALS) are preferred for collecting point cloud data to measure relatively substantial dimensions like vertical clearance, curves, location, deck attributes, and girder spacing.
Following the sparse point cloud, the ensuing stage aims to generate a denser point cloud using the Multi-View Stereo (MVS) technique (Fig. 16d).
